events.head: Find Team chat label and check mirror
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -n -i "chat" app/src/components/masterclass/funnel-os-types/{book,waterfall,hub-spoke}.tsx | head -8; git log --oneline -3 --grep "T-295"; git log origin/main --oneline -1 --grep "T-295"; curl -s "https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/funnels/book/?v=$(date +%s)" -o /tmp/b.html -w "%{http_code}\n"; grep -o -i "slack\|team chat" /tmp/b.html | sort | uniq -c

events.name: Bash
events.head: Trace Slack/Team chat changes and mirror
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git log --oneline -S"slack" -i -- app/src/components/masterclass/ | head -5; grep -rn -i "slack\|team chat" app/src/components/masterclass/ | head -5; grep -n -i "slack\|team chat\|youtube\|amazon" app/src/components/masterclass/funnel-os.tsx | head -8; for r in book waterfall hub-spoke; do curl -s "https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/funnels/$r/?v=$(date +%s)" | grep -o -i "slack\|team chat\|youtube\|amazon" | sort | uniq -c | tr '\n' ' '; echo " $r"; done

events.name: Bash
events.head: See what replaced Slack in the boards
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git show 7cb1dd64 -- app/src/components/masterclass/funnel-os-types/book.tsx app/src/components/masterclass/funnel-os-types/waterfall.tsx app/src/components/masterclass/funnel-os-types/hub-spoke.tsx | grep -i -B1 -A1 "^-.*slack" | head -20; ls app/public/brand/logos/tools/ | grep -c -E "amazon|youtube"; git merge-base --is-ancestor e5fbf418 origin/main && echo engine-on-origin

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find commit that touched slack in boards
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git log --oneline -i -G"slack" -- app/src/components/masterclass/funnel-os-types/ | head; git log -1 --format=%H -i -G"slack" -- app/src/components/masterclass/funnel-os-types/ | xargs -I{} git show {} -- app/src/components/masterclass/funnel-os-types/ | grep -i "^[-+].*\(slack\|chat\)" | head -10
